payload.name: Extract all explicitly stated participant actions
payload.description: When a user message describes a shared activity with distinct roles for multiple participants, use this during extraction to ensure every explicitly stated participant action is captured in a memory candidate.
content: During extraction, if a message states a compound activity with multiple participants, create candidates that include every explicitly stated participant-action pair; do not let the most salient action suppress the speaker's own explicitly stated action.

Before accepting an ADD/UPDATE/MERGE, compare the candidate against the source message and confirm each distinct claim is represented; if a claim is missing, add or amend a candidate rather than accepting an incomplete summary.

solves: During extraction, a compound sentence describing a shared activity often gets compressed to one salient participant's action, dropping an explicitly stated action by another participant. Generalized rule: ensure every distinctly stated participant-action pair in a source message is represented in candidates. Applies to any shared activity with distinct roles; does not infer unstated details.
